metadata.explanation: Under the status lock, end a denied subagent, reporting one whose start a Stop overtook, stop one that a Stop reached while it initialized, or start its loop beside its deadline.
Wait for the deadline of the subagent's duration limit, then end its loop as timed out.
Join the results of a read-only wave exactly once; a wave that lost its lease is routed again after a refresh.
End the loop of a running subagent once: it completed with its report or failed.
Make one model call and record its reply; a reply without tools ends the task with a report.
Summarize the context segment and open the next one with the summary and the task.
Run one branch of a read-only wave and publish its result.
Run one tool on the lease copy in the worktree, with the call's stable identity and bounded execution.
Stop a command the loop left running and save the worktree into its result ref, keeping the changes for the merge.
Ask the Session to admit the subagent, then freeze its configuration and open its first segment with the task, holding no status lock.
Fail a subagent whose Session could not be asked to admit it, without an effect, and report the failure.
Fail the subagent whose model call, compaction or lease refresh could not finish, with the bounded cause.
Record how the subagent ended, drain the results of a stopped wave and report the end.
Record a serial call whose retries are exhausted as a platform failure the model reads, with an unknown effect for a call that may change the worktree.
Complete a subagent whose report could not be delivered within its wait limit; its outcome stays readable.
Publish a classified failure for one branch whose retries are exhausted.
Ask the Session every ten seconds for the lease of its current instance when the finishing subagent's copy proved unreachable, then save the worktree on it.
Ask the Session every ten seconds for the lease of its instance after the transport proved the subagent's copy unreachable.
Deliver the task notification of the end to the Session, waiting while its queue is full, then complete.
Return a connector check failure to the developer for repair, or end after the failure limit.
Answer a call the subagent may not make or set_effort, or run the call serially or in a read-only wave.
Settle a command past its timeout or exhausted retries from the ledger: a subagent's command is stopped, never moved to the background.
